description: Look up one book in the ShelfClub catalog, by its ShelfClub id or by ISBN. Returns its description, authors, reader rating, series, an edition (ISBN, page count, publisher, publication date, language), its shelfclub.app link, and its mood, vibe, pace and genre tags (machine-generated, or voted for by at least three readers of the book). A lookup by id also returns the ShelfClub author id of each author that has an author record, and which of the moods, vibes and pace readers of the book voted for, with how many did. These tools do not return content warnings: if asked, say so, and do not infer them from the tags or present anything as ShelfClub's.

id.description: The ShelfClub id of the book, as the other tools return it. Give this or `isbn`, not both.

isbn.description: An ISBN-10 or ISBN-13, with or without hyphens.
